result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, both restaurant sections and the bottom navigation are aligned and legible with no overlapping or clipped text (aside from the allowed carousel/viewport edge cases). The only questionable element is the profile avatar in the top-right, which appears as an empty gray circle with a stray red dot.

issues.description: The circular avatar/profile control in the top-right corner is an empty gray circle with no image, initials or icon; the small red notification dot sits inside the circle rather than on its edge, making the element look like an unloaded placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Render the user's avatar image or a fallback (initials/person icon) inside the circle, and position the notification badge overlapping the circle's top-right edge so it reads as a badge rather than a stray dot.
